synthesis.climate_context: Insufficient local data — recommend manual research
synthesis.building_stock: The returned records evidence a split between apartment stock and standalone dwellings but say nothing about door material or thickness: South Yarra is classified as 'Inner Melbourne' in the smart-lock installer service list (thesmartlockshop.com.au/smart-lock-installation-melbourne) and sits in the same service block as Southbank, Prahran, Toorak and Windsor (smartlocksmelbourne.au/pages/service-areas-smart-lock-installation), while a specialist installer records bulk Samsung digital-lock rollouts of 2,200+ units across named VIC apartment buildings including Yarra One, Montague Square and Victoriana (smartlockinstallation.com.au) — so apartment entry doors are often specified at building level; against that, the one actual South Yarra job detail returned is a standalone front door with a knob-and-deadlock lockset where one cylinder side had failed (knob turns, deadlock will not retract) that was resolved by fitting a new lock (airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/south-yarra-vic), and South Yarra locksmith pages still list traditional door and window locks alongside keyless entry (southyarralocksmiths.com.au, globallocksmiths.com.au/south-yarra).
synthesis.council_notes: None identified — no heritage overlay, owners-corporation or rental-provider rule appears in any returned record; the only adjacent signal is the South Yarra locksmith page that frames work for 'a homeowner, tenant or a landlord' on 'your home or investment property' (24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au/emergency-locksmith-southyarra), which implies third-party consent conversations but evidences no specific regulation.
synthesis.demographic_skew: The South Yarra records skew toward a mixed owner/renter/landlord occupancy with property turnover as an explicit trigger — the local page addresses 'a homeowner, tenant or a landlord' and leads with 'Changing the Keys of the existing locks when moving in' to a 'home or investment property' (24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au/emergency-locksmith-southyarra) — and includes a commercial component, since South Yarra work is advertised for 'homes and businesses' (allsecurelocksmiths.com.au/locksmith-south-yarra) and 'home or business security' (newgenlocksmith.com.au/services/smart-lock-installation).
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock will retrofit onto the mechanical hardware already on the door or the whole lockset has to be replaced — the one South Yarra job detail returned is a front door with a knob-and-deadlock set where the pin-cylinder side had failed and the fix was installing a new lock, listed on the same page as the task 'Install smart door lock' (airtasker.com/au/services/locksmith/south-yarra-vic), and local pages keep 'traditional Deadlocks' and 'Digital Smart Locks' as one combined repair-and-installation service (24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au/emergency-locksmith-southyarra).

Who is allowed to authorise the change on a tenanted or landlord-owned property, and whether it happens at move-in — the South Yarra page explicitly separates 'homeowner, tenant or a landlord' and anchors the job to 'Changing the Keys of the existing locks when moving in' on an 'investment property' (24hmelbournelocksmith.com.au/emergency-locksmith-southyarra).

In apartment stock, whether a unit owner can choose their own smart lock or is tied to a building-standard system — whole-building Samsung digital-lock rollouts across named VIC apartment buildings (Aurora Central, Yarra One, Montague Square, Victoriana) are advertised as an assigned, building-scale contract of 2,200+ locks (smartlockinstallation.com.au), and South Yarra is served inside that same Inner Melbourne footprint (thesmartlockshop.com.au/smart-lock-installation-melbourne).

Which product to buy and who supports it after the install, given locks are sold online here — the Melbourne smart-lock service-area page covering South Yarra pairs 'Order your Smart Lock safely online' with assistance 'from product selection to post-installation support' (smartlocksmelbourne.au/pages/service-areas-smart-lock-installation), so buyers are picking the hardware themselves before an installer is engaged.
